title.narrative: Biodiverse, sustainable, resilient and inclusive cities
Città biodiverse, sostenibili, resilienti e inclusive in Colombia

description.narrative: L’iniziativa intende contribuire a creare città intermedie più sostenibili e climaticamente resilienti, che conservino la biodiversità e che tengano in conto la protezione della natura e dell’ambiente circostante nei loro processi di pianificazione urbana, al fine di ottenere un impatto positivo sull’economia locale, la qualità dell’ambiente e il benessere delle persone. Le due città individuate per la realizzazione del progetto sono Leticia, nel Dipartimento di Amazonas e l’isola di San Andrés, facente parte dell’Arcipelago di San Andrés, Providencia e Santa Catalina. Entrambe le località fanno parte del Programma “Città Biodiverse e Resilienti” del Ministero dell’Ambiente e dello Sviluppo Sostenibile che ha avuto lo scopo di individuare 14 città colombiane dove iniziare un processo di incorporazione della biodiversità nello sviluppo e nella pianificazione urbana. L’iniziativa sviluppa azioni che favoriscono l’integrazione della biodiversità come opportunità per lo sviluppo economico e sociale e si basa su cinque assi principali d’intervento: formazione e costruzione di capacità, formulazione di strumenti di politica pubblica per i processi di pianificazione e sviluppo urbano, disegno e realizzazione di opere d’infrastruttura, creazione di impieghi verdi e attività di ricerca, sviluppo tecnologico e innovazione per migliorare la conoscenza, protezione e uso sostenibile delle risorse della biodiversità. Per assicurare il gender mainstreaming, si procederá a condurre un’analisi di genere come prima attività del progetto e si elaborerà una strategia che permetta il pieno coinvolgimento delle donne nelle attività progettuali.

The initiative aims to contribute to creating more sustainable and climate-resilient intermediate cities that preserve biodiversity and consider the protection of nature and the surrounding environment in their urban planning processes, with the goal of achieving a positive impact on the local economy, environmental quality, and the well-being of people. The two cities identified for the project implementation are Leticia in the Amazonas Department and the island of San Andrés, part of the Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia, and Santa Catalina. Both locations are part of the "Biodiverse and Resilient Cities" program of the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development, which aimed to identify 14 Colombian cities to initiate a process of incorporating biodiversity into urban development and planning. The initiative develops actions that promote the integration of biodiversity as an opportunity for economic and social development and is based on five main intervention axes: training and capacity building, formulation of public policy tools for planning and urban development processes, design and implementation of infrastructure works, creation of green jobs and research activities, technological development, and innovation to improve knowledge, protection, and sustainable use of biodiversity resources.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
By 2020, integrate ecosystem and biodiversity values into national and local planning, development processes, poverty reduction strategies and accounts

By 2020, substantially increase the number of cities and human settlements adopting and implementing integrated policies and plans towards inclusion, resource efficiency, mitigation and adaptation to climate change, resilience to disasters, and develop and implement, in line with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015–2030, holistic disaster risk management at all levels
By 2030, devise and implement policies to promote sustainable tourism that creates jobs and promotes local culture and products
By 2030, enhance inclusive and sustainable urbanization and capacity for participatory, integrated and sustainable human settlement planning and management in all countries
By 2030, provide universal access to safe, inclusive and accessible, green and public spaces, in particular for women and children, older persons and persons with disabilities
By 2030, reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, including by paying special attention to air quality and municipal and other waste management
Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
Mobilize and significantly increase financial resources from all sources to conserve and sustainably use biodiversity and ecosystems
Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt and reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss
Take urgent and significant action to reduce the degradation of natural habitats, halt the loss of biodiversity and, by 2020, protect and prevent the extinction of threatened species
